cover.title: Don't take anything from this town

lines.text: Go ahead. Walk through this town. Just don't take anything home.
You're in Bodie, California. In 1879, thousands of people lived here, chasing gold. Around two thousand buildings.
Then the gold ran out. A fire in 1932 destroyed most of what was left. By the 1940s, almost everyone was gone.
Since 1962, the state has kept it just as they left it. Desks in the schoolhouse. Dishes in the kitchens. They call it arrested decay.
Now you spot a nail on the ground. A bit of old glass. You slip it in your pocket.
That's the curse of Bodie. Take something, and bad luck follows you... until you give it back.
Packages still arrive at the park. Nails. Bottles. Rocks. With letters begging forgiveness.
Some say the rangers made the curse up, to stop people stealing. The letters keep coming anyway.
Ever taken something you shouldn't have? Comment give it back, partner.
